title: Half of Retirees Were Forced Out — $312K Gone
hook: You've been planning to retire at 65, but statistically you'll stop working at 62 — and you won't choose when.
angle: Involuntary early retirement is the most common retirement outcome, yet nobody plans for it — the forced exit triggers SS cuts and kills compounding, costing $312K on average
audience: Workers 45-60 who are planning for retirement but not planning for an involuntary early exit
